name: Armageddon
description: Every combatant (enemies, allies and the caster alike) takes 4 dice of fire damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels).
appearanceDescription: The sky turns crimson and rains fire that spares neither friend nor foe. The ground melts, the air roars, and the caster stands in the middle of the inferno, laughing through the burns.

name: Avatar
description: Personal spell: Markel summons an Avatar of Death (the DM can swap the unit in the spell editor). The summoner controls the Avatar.
appearanceDescription: The air before the caster thickens and shimmers, as if over hot stone. A majestic faceless figure forms out of shadow and light and silently takes its place beside the caster, ready for battle.

name: Berserk
description: The enemy makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it goes berserk for 1 round: on its turn it automatically attacks a random other creature (its own allies included) with +50% damage. Does not affect heroes.
appearanceDescription: The enemy's eyes fill with blood and a bestial roar tears from its throat. It no longer sees faces, only targets, and lunges at the first one in reach, even if it is its own brother-in-arms.

name: Blindness
description: The enemy makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failure it cannot attack (in melee or at range) or cast spells for 2 rounds. The effect ends as soon as the enemy takes damage. On a success, no effect.
appearanceDescription: A black veil closes over the enemy's eyes, as if someone had thrown a velvet cloth over them. It flails at the empty air while only the soft laughter of darkness echoes around it.

name: Call of the Phoenix
description: Summons a Phoenix controlled by the player: it flies, strikes two enemies with fiery claws, is immune to fire, and is reborn from the flames once per battle. The Phoenix's health, damage and attack grow with the caster's level.
appearanceDescription: The druid hurls a handful of embers into the ground, and a pillar of flame rises over the battlefield. A Phoenix spreads its burning wings and soars out of the fire with a cry; even death only briefly returns it to ash.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Lightning leaps between enemies (up to 4): the first target takes 2 dice of lightning damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels), and each following target takes half of the previous one (100% → 50% → 25% → 13%). On the map the caster picks the first target within 60 ft, and the lightning jumps by itself to the enemy nearest to the previous target; without a map, up to 4 enemies of your choice in jump order.
appearanceDescription: A blinding discharge leaps from the caster's fingers and, after striking the first enemy, jumps to the next, and on, and on. The air crackles and smells of a thunderstorm, and each jump is a little dimmer than the last.

name: Circle of Winter
description: A ring with a 10 ft radius (3×3 around a point) within 60 ft, the center cell is not affected: every creature in the ring, allies and the caster included, makes a Constitution saving throw; each takes 3 dice of cold damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) and −2 to initiative for 1 round. On a success, half damage and no initiative penalty. Without a map, up to 3 enemies of your choice.
appearanceDescription: An icy ring spreads outward from the caster, and the grass in its path is covered with hoarfrost. The enemies freeze in crunching rime, exhaling clouds of white vapor.

name: Cleansing
description: Removes all negative effects and conditions (debuffs, poisons, control) from an ally.
appearanceDescription: Clear white water pours from the heavens onto an ally, though there are no clouds over the battlefield. Dark stains of curses hiss like coals in a spring and dissolve without a trace.

name: Confusion
description: The enemy makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure, for 2 rounds at the start of each of its turns it has a 50% chance to lose its action. On a success, no effect.
appearanceDescription: Hundreds of whispers rise in the enemy's head, each calling in a different direction. It freezes with its weapon raised and looks around, recognizing neither friends nor foes.

name: Curse of the Netherworld
description: All enemies take 4 dice of necrotic damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) and lose 1 morale.
appearanceDescription: The ground parts beneath the enemies, and ghostly hands rise from the cracks, cold as a gravestone. They seize the living by the ankles, draining away warmth and hope.

name: Deep Freeze
description: The enemy makes a Constitution saving throw; it takes 6 dice of cold damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) and cannot act for 1 round. On a success, half damage and no freezing.
appearanceDescription: In an instant a thick layer of blue ice engulfs the enemy, and it freezes like a statue in a winter garden. Its wide eyes are visible through the ice, and the silence around turns ringing, like on a frosty night.

name: Divine Retribution
description: Deals 6 dice of radiant damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) to an enemy. The more wounded the caster, the stronger the retribution: damage increases by 1% for every 1% of the caster's HP lost (at half HP, ×1.5).
appearanceDescription: The caster's blood dripping onto the ground bursts into white flame. A pillar of blinding light strikes down from the sky, and the deeper the righteous one's wounds, the more merciless the punishment that falls upon the wrongdoer.

name: Divine Strength
description: An ally deals 25% more damage with all attacks and spells for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: A thin golden halo flares above the ally's head, and the weapon in their hands begins to ring like a cathedral bell. Every blow leaves a bright trail in the air that smells of incense.

name: Earthquake
description: A circle with a 20 ft radius within 60 ft: every creature in it, allies and the caster included, makes a Dexterity saving throw; each takes 2 dice of bludgeoning damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) and attacks with disadvantage for 1 round. On a success, half damage and no disadvantage. Without a map, up to 6 enemies of your choice.
appearanceDescription: The druid strikes the ground with a staff, and the battlefield shudders with a deep rumble. The soil cracks, enemies fall to their knees, and dust and the smell of raw clay rise from the fissures.

name: Eldritch Arrow
description: Deals 3 dice of fire damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) to an enemy.
appearanceDescription: An arrow of violet flame tears from the caster's palm, leaving a smell of sulfur behind. It never misses; it simply sinks into the target and bursts in a shower of sparks.

name: Entangle
description: A 15 ft square within 60 ft: every creature in it, allies and the caster included, makes a Strength saving throw; those who fail cannot make melee attacks for 1 round. On a success, no effect. Without a map, up to 3 enemies of your choice.
appearanceDescription: The grass around the enemies suddenly comes alive and turns stiff as wire. The stems weave into a dense net, and every step forward ends in a fall.

name: Eternal Light
description: An ally restores 4 dice of healing (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) HP, and then heals for 10% of maximum HP at the start of each of its turns for 2 more rounds. Granted by a skill of the Light branch.
appearanceDescription: A small sun blossoms above the ally, and its rays pass through the armor straight to the heart. The wounds glow from within and vanish, and the radiance lingers for a long time, quietly warming the flesh.

name: Evasion
description: An ally takes 50% less damage from ranged attacks for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: A barely visible veil of light shimmers around the ally, and arrows flying into it veer aside as if pushed by an invisible palm. Crossbow bolts fall into the grass with a dull thud.

name: Fire Wall
description: A line of fire 30 ft long extending from the caster: everyone in it, allies included, takes 1 die of fire damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels). The fire burns for 3 rounds: anyone who enters the line or starts their turn in it takes the damage of that roll again. Without a map, up to 6 enemies of your choice, and the fire does not remain on the field.
appearanceDescription: A roaring wall of fire rises from the ground before the enemy ranks, taller than a man. The heat scorches faces, the smoke stings the eyes, and a strip of flame stays on the ground for a few more rounds, burning everyone who steps into it.

name: Fireball
description: A circle with a 10 ft radius within 120 ft: every creature in it, allies and the caster included, makes a Dexterity saving throw and takes 3 dice of fire damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels), or half on a success. Without a map, up to 3 enemies of your choice.
appearanceDescription: A hot orange sphere swells between the caster's palms, humming like a glowing forge. It explodes among the enemies, and the flames roll out in a circle, devouring grass and cloaks.

name: Forest Rebirth
description: Returns fallen allies to the battle with 30% of maximum HP.
appearanceDescription: Young shoots sprout above the fallen and in a moment become flowering bushes. When the petals fall, warriors rise in their place, with leaves tangled in their hair.

name: Forest Spirit
description: For 3 rounds, an ally restores 10% of maximum HP at the start of each of its turns and has 50% resistance to poison.
appearanceDescription: A translucent stag with branching antlers, in which fireflies sleep, appears behind the ally. Its breath smells of resin and returns strength to every wounded sinew.

name: Frailty
description: An enemy gets −2 AC for 3 rounds. Repeated applications stack, up to three times (−6 AC); each application lasts 3 rounds separately, and a fourth one refreshes the duration of the oldest.
appearanceDescription: Black rust creeps across the enemy's armor, and the skin beneath it turns gray and cracks like old parchment. Steel that yesterday withstood an axe blow now softens under the fingers.

name: Haste
description: An ally gets +3 to initiative and +10 ft (2 cells) to speed for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: A whirl of white feathers swirls around the ally's feet, and the world around seems to slow down. Their steps become light, and their cloak flutters though there is no wind.

name: Healing Wave
description: Every ally restores 3 dice of healing (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) HP.
appearanceDescription: A green wave rolls out from the druid, and wildflowers bloom where it passes. The allies breathe in the scent of a spring forest, and weariness and wounds recede.

name: Healing Word
description: As a bonus action, an ally restores 3 dice of healing (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) HP.
appearanceDescription: The caster whispers a short word, and the ally is wrapped in the smell of fresh grass after rain. The wounds close with a greenish light, like young bark.

name: Ice Bolt
description: Deals 3 dice of cold damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) to an enemy; the enemy attacks with disadvantage for 1 round.
appearanceDescription: The air crackles with frost, and a blue ice spear grows in the caster's hand. It flies with a whistle and shatters against the target, covering it with rime and binding its joints.

name: Implosion
description: Deals 8 dice of force damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) to an enemy.
appearanceDescription: The space around the enemy contracts to a point, and light bends its rays as it falls inward. The armor crumples like parchment, and then everything tears apart in a dull, crushing blast.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Deals 3 dice of lightning damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) to an enemy; the enemy gets −2 to initiative for 2 rounds.
appearanceDescription: The sky splits with a blinding fork, and thunder strikes straight at the enemy. Smoke pours off it, its hair stands on end, and its muscles twitch in spasms for a long time.

name: Magic Immunity
description: For 2 rounds, an ally takes no damage from spells and is immune to all control conditions.
appearanceDescription: A crystal sphere wraps around the ally, with rainbow waves running across it. Enemy spells break against it like sea foam against a rock and crumble into sparkling dust.

name: Meteor Shower
description: A circle with a 20 ft radius within 120 ft: every creature in it, allies and the caster included, makes a Dexterity saving throw; each takes 2 dice of bludgeoning damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels), or half on a success. Without a map, up to 6 enemies of your choice.
appearanceDescription: The sky darkens, and glowing boulders fall from it, leaving fiery tails behind. The ground shudders at the impacts, craters smoke, and shards of rock whistle overhead.

name: Moonbeam
description: Deals 3 dice of radiant damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) to an enemy, and moonlight lights it up: for its next 2 turns all attacks against it have advantage.
appearanceDescription: Even in broad daylight a silver pillar of moonlight falls from the sky and pins the enemy to the ground. The cold radiance does not fade after the strike: the enemy glows like a target, and no shadow can hide it.

name: Nature's Storm
description: All enemies take 3 dice of lightning damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) and cannot cast spells for 1 round.
appearanceDescription: The sky above the battlefield turns black, the wind howls, breaking trees, and lightning strikes the enemy ranks one after another. The roar of the downpour drowns out the words of the spell, and the enemy mages can only swallow water helplessly.

name: Plague
description: Poisons an enemy: a roll of 1 die of poison damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) determines the damage the enemy takes at the start of each of its turns for 2 rounds.
appearanceDescription: A cloud of greenish flies bursts from the caster's palm and fastens onto the enemy's face. The skin is covered with black blisters, and its breath reeks of a rotting crypt.

name: Puppet Master
description: The enemy makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it switches to the caster's side for 1 round and acts under the control of the caster's player, then returns. Does not affect heroes.
appearanceDescription: Thin silver threads stretch from the caster's fingers and catch on the enemy's wrists and neck. It jerks like a puppet at a fair and obediently turns its weapon against its own.

name: Regeneration
description: At the start of each of its turns, an ally restores 10% of maximum HP. Lasts 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: A warm amber glow spreads beneath the ally's skin, and the wounds close with thin golden threads. With every breath the light pulses like a second heart.

name: Resurrection
description: Returns a fallen ally to the battle with 50% of maximum HP.
appearanceDescription: A column of soft light descends over the fallen body, with white lily petals swirling in it. The chest rises in a first breath, and the eyes open, full of quiet wonder.

name: Righteous Might
description: An ally gets +3 to attack rolls and +15% damage for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: The ally's figure grows in radiance, as if an invisible angel were spreading its wings behind them. The muscles swell with strength, and the gaze becomes firm and clear, like steel at dawn.

name: Roots
description: The enemy makes a Strength saving throw; on a failure it cannot move or attack (in melee or at range) for 1 round and gets −2 to initiative. On a success, no effect.
appearanceDescription: The ground beneath the enemy's feet splits open, and gnarled roots burst out, winding around ankles and knees. They smell of damp clay and an old forest.

name: Slow
description: The enemy makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it gets −3 to initiative and −10 ft (2 cells) to speed for 3 rounds. On a success, no effect.
appearanceDescription: The air thickens around the enemy, as if it were underwater. Every movement stretches out, sounds grow muffled, and a blink of the eyes lasts a whole century.

name: Sorrow
description: The enemy's morale is reduced by 2 for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: A tiny rain cloud gathers above the enemy and sheds a cold drizzle. The fire dies in its eyes, and its heart fills with longing for a home it may never see again.

name: Stone Spikes
description: A cross with arms 5 ft long (the center and the four adjacent cells) within 60 ft: every creature in it, allies included, takes 2 dice of bludgeoning damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels). Without a map, up to 3 enemies of your choice.
appearanceDescription: The ground beneath the enemies shudders, and sharp stone spires leap out of it like the teeth of a huge beast. Shards of rock fly apart, leaving clouds of dust behind.

name: Stoneskin
description: An ally gets +3 to AC for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: The ally's skin is covered with a gray granite pattern that gleams like the marble of temple columns. Enemy blades clang against it, striking sparks.

name: Suffering
description: An enemy gets −3 to attack rolls for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: Invisible hooks sink into the enemy's veins, and every swing answers with burning pain. It grimaces, its hands tremble, and the blade keeps passing wide of the target.

name: Summon Air Elemental
description: Summons an air elemental (usually one per battle, as 3rd-level slots are few): its health, damage and attack grow with the caster's level. The elemental is controlled by the player.
appearanceDescription: A whirlwind rises from beneath the caster's feet, and amid dust and lightning a transparent figure takes shape, one that never misses. The caster extends a hand, and the elemental takes their side.

name: Summon Earth Elemental
description: Summons an earth elemental (usually one per battle, as 3rd-level slots are few): its health, damage and attack grow with the caster's level. The elemental is controlled by the player.
appearanceDescription: The ground splits open, and a boulder rises from it and assembles into a massive giant with eyes of glowing stone. The caster extends a hand, and the elemental takes their side.

name: Summon Fire Elemental
description: Summons a fire elemental (usually one per battle, as 3rd-level slots are few): its health, damage and attack grow with the caster's level. The elemental is controlled by the player.
appearanceDescription: Flames condense into a humanoid figure that crackles with heat and leaves scorched footprints on the ground. The caster extends a hand, and the elemental takes their side.

name: Summon Water Elemental
description: Summons a water elemental (usually one per battle, as 3rd-level slots are few): its health, damage and attack grow with the caster's level. The elemental is controlled by the player.
appearanceDescription: A water column bursts from the air and settles into a figure of waves and ice, cold to the touch even from afar. The caster extends a hand, and the elemental takes their side.

name: Teleportation
description: Moves an ally to any free point on the battlefield. There is no mechanic for it in the tracker: it spends a slot and an action, and the DM plays out the movement on the map.
appearanceDescription: The ally crumbles into a column of golden sparks that hang in the air for a moment. Elsewhere on the battlefield the sparks gather again, and they are already standing there, swaying slightly from dizziness.

spellEffects.text: Teleportation: the DM moves the target to any free point on the battlefield.

name: Thorny Vines
description: Poisonous vines wrap around an enemy: a roll of 1 die of poison damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) determines the damage the enemy takes at the start of each of its turns for 3 rounds.
appearanceDescription: Dark green shoots covered in thorns rise from the ground, oozing yellow sap. They wind around the enemy and tighten with its every movement.

name: Vampirism
description: For 3 rounds, an ally's attacks heal them for 50% of the damage dealt.
appearanceDescription: The ally's teeth lengthen and the skin takes on a deathly pallor. Every wound they inflict oozes a red mist that streams toward their lips and restores their strength.

name: Wasp Swarm
description: A circle with a 5 ft radius within 60 ft: every creature in it, allies and the caster included, takes 2 dice of piercing damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels) and −2 to initiative for 2 rounds. Without a map, up to 3 enemies of your choice.
appearanceDescription: A buzzing cloud of finger-sized wasps flies out of the druid's sleeve. They circle the enemies, stinging faces and necks, and the enemies swat at them, forgetting about the fight.

name: Weakness
description: The enemy makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it deals 25% less damage for 3 rounds. On a success, no effect.
appearanceDescription: Gray fog creeps into the enemy's sleeves, and the weapon suddenly grows heavy in its hands. The fingers weaken, the shoulders sag, and the blows become feeble, like a sick man's.

name: Word of Light
description: All enemies take 3 dice of radiant damage (d6/d8/d10 depending on school mastery; +1 die per 3 hero levels). Humans, Elves, Dwarves and Mages are immune to it, since light does not punish the good.
appearanceDescription: The caster speaks a single word, and it thunders like a thousand bells. White radiance floods the battlefield: dark creatures burn and writhe, while good hearts only feel the warm breath of dawn.
